intro: The Seychelles includes granite islands, unusual in the ocean, and low coral islands.

chapters.title: Islands
text: Mahé, Praslin and La Digue are granite islands with huge boulders on their beaches. The Vallée de Mai on Praslin is home to the coco de mer, the world's largest seed. Aldabra Atoll has over 100,000 giant tortoises.

chapters.title: Climate
text: The Seychelles is warm all year and lies outside the cyclone belt.

keyTerms.meaning: A palm with the world's largest seed.
